newsitem.title: USA: GM REPORTS STRONG Q2 NET DESPITE STRIKES.
newsitem.headline: GM REPORTS STRONG Q2 NET DESPITE STRIKES.

text.p: General Motors Corp. on Wednesday reported a strong second-quarter profit of $2.1 billion as two extraordinary gains helped offset the $490 million negative effect of two assembly plant strikes.

GM's earnings, which came to $2.68 a share, compared with year ago profits of $1.9 billion, or $2.63 a share. The second quarter was an all-time record on a per-share basis due to $2 billion in stock repurchases made by GM so far this year. MORE 161257 GMT jul 97
